description: VOXEL-MAN Visible Human Male aorta surface extracted from segmented 1 mm label images.
attribution: Höhne, Karl Heinz; Pflesser, Bernhard; Pommert, Andreas; Riemer, Martin; Schiemann, Thomas; Schubert, Rainer; Schumacher, Udo; Tiede, Ulf. Segmented Internal Organs of the Visible Human Male (2025), University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf / VOXEL-MAN. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15882019
changes: Selected labels extracted on the 1 mm grid; Gaussian sigma 0.6 voxel and marching cubes at 0.5. TIFF stack kji mapped to (i,j,-k) meters with reversed winding, then rotated to glTF Y-up by (x,y,z) -> (x,z,-y). Source TIFFs unchanged.

extraction.original_array_mapping: TIFF stack kji -> (i,j,-k) * 0.001 meters; extraction reverses triangle winding.

limitations: Main systemic branches not separately labeled in this source
Extracted for reference viewing; connectivity and watertightness are not certified.
intended_use: Shape and topology guidance for agentic refinement of target anatomy; do not replace the target with this reference.
alignment: Reference coordinates only; registration to each target is required.
